authority: Explicit user direction: Zaun must visibly emphasize chemtech, a chempunk vibe, neon chemical green with purples and browns wherever appropriate.
supersedes: Earlier amber-dominant, barely visible desaturated green palette
preserved: Original Heroes III native painted/prerendered rendering language
Twenty independent town sites and thirty-six separate construction states
Eleven selected local champions and their individual identities
Existing creature anatomy, roles, equipment identity and coherent action poses
Separate functional building layers, derived click geometry and upgrade readability
Exact source provenance, historical paintings and strict release gates

palette.signatureLight: Strong luminous toxic/neon chemical green from visible reagent fluids, glass pressure cells, pipes and machinery; clearly readable at native size.
palette.secondary: Bruised purple, plum cloth and violet reagent glass or atmospheric depth.
palette.materialBase: Brown leather, tarred timber, rusty iron, corroded copper, weathered brick and wet ochre concrete.
palette.amber: Secondary heat/furnace light, not the dominant chemical identity.
palette.lighting: Broad top-left illumination plus localized chemical emission and nearby reflections; preserve material texture and separation.
palette.avoid: Uniform green hue filters, glowing ordinary skin/metal, blanket neon outlines, featureless saturated blobs, illegible signage and flat modern UI.

town.layout: Latest user direction supersedes the old rigid rows and preservation of old site boxes. Use organic industrial street clusters across more of the 800 x 374 canvas, irregular depth and visible paths; foreground buildings should be somewhat larger than comparable distant structures. Keep twenty independent sites/thirty-six functional states, readable roles, proper render order and exposed click targets. Natural partial occlusion is allowed; no building may be completely hidden or become unselectable.
town.background: Empty organically sloping industrial ground with winding streets, short irregular retaining edges, integrated reagent conduits, localized green runoff/reflections and purple depth. Avoid three rigid parallel platforms. Do not bake functional construction into the background.
town.buildingStates: Each role remains legible. Add believable connected chemtech: green glass tanks, pressure gauges, pumps, dosing lines, condenser vents, salvage machinery, purple glass/cloth and brown industrial materials where the building's function supports them.
town.civilianServices: Market, tavern, clinic, administration and dock remain recognizably their own services; use smaller connected pipes, lamps and trade/workshop details rather than making every site a generic reactor.
town.upgrades: Keep the same site while increasing industrial enclosure, reagent control, reinforcement and machinery. Base states remain visibly simpler.
town.coherence: Revise building layers, construction icons, adventure states and town icons together; review siege, puzzle and UI assets for appropriate coherence. A new background alone does not complete the town revision.

creatureApplication.tier1: Ordinary worker keeps cheap brown cloth and plain iron; upgraded Chem Punk can show a green reagent vial/tool detail and a purple cloth patch. No forced glow on a plain pipe.
creatureApplication.tier2: Green dosing ampoules/reservoirs and purple straps over brown harness and living skin; regeneration is not a magical green regrowth animation.
creatureApplication.tier3: Clearly readable green reagent pressure chamber/nozzle apparatus, purple marking/glass and weathered metal; the mechanical line remains distinct.
creatureApplication.tier4: Localized green pressure-cell inspection windows on augmented equipment, plum/brown work clothing and metal; ordinary cleaver/head identity stays intact.
creatureApplication.tier5: The chemical-working line has especially clear green reagents and violet glass/cloth accents; preserve the female alchemist identity and paid reagent casting.
creatureApplication.tier6: Green fluid cells or tubing on plausible prosthetic/tool hardware with brown/purple work materials; preserve the long-tool silhouette.
creatureApplication.tier7: Organic brown wet hide and purple scar tissue, restrained existing chemical-green marks; never retcon the lab animal into a machine or fluorescent magical dragon.

champions: Preserve canonical/local identity colors and biographies. Appropriate chemical gear may glow green, but Jinx's blue hair, Vi's identity, Ekko's individual invention and mechanical legacy Viktor are not uniformly recolored or reclassified as generic chemtech troops.
production: Use genuine image-generation edits or authored source painting. No Python color wash/glow repaint. Technical crop, uniform scaling, canvas placement and diagnostic assembly remain permitted. Preserve every earlier selected or rejected source with provenance; select a new coherent revision only after native comparison.

verification.scope: Town source selection is complete. Current conversion reports govern compiled freshness; remaining appropriate unit and auxiliary palette work is tracked separately. These source observations grant no native game or final art acceptance.
